title: Technology Sector Update for 01/05/2018: GPRO,CNIT,CSCO,AAPL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT +1.18%
AAPL +1.02%
IBM +0.12%
CSCO +1.37%
GOOG +1.43%
Technology stocks were sharply higher Friday, with shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 adding more than 0.9% in value while the Philadelphia semiconductor index was posting an 0.8% gain.
In industry news:
Apple ( AAPL ) rose Friday after the tech giant said it will soon be providing Mac and iOS users with a patch addressing the Meltdown and Spectre security issues recently uncovered due to semiconductor design flaws. In a statement, the company said there were "no known exploits impacting customers at this time" resulting from the recently discovered semiconductor design flaws and will be releasing iOS 11.2, macOS 10.13.2 and tvOS 11.2 mitigations to help defend against Meltdown. More mitigations were due "in coming days" to address Spectre risks.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
- GoPro ( GPRO ) was grounded Friday, with shares of the wearable camera company sliding as much as 1% lower following reports the company is cutting between 200 to 300 jobs in its aerial drone division, which was responsible for GoPro's poorly selling Karma drones. Citing sources close to the company, TechCrunch said the layoffs began Thursday, although the affected employees will be paid through Feb. 16. The company reportedly told employees in a memo that the new restructuring effort is intended to "better align our resources with business requirements." Prior realignments trimmed about 15% of its then-workforce in 2016 and cost about 270 employees their jobs in March 2017.
In other sector news:
+ China Information Technology ( CNIT ) rallied Friday after selling 5,000 terminals to a Beijing ad agency earlier this week.
- Cisco Systems was falling Friday afternoon despite analysts at Bank of America Merrill Lynch raising their investment recommendation for the company's stock to Buy From Neutral.
